options.name: content
options.description: Sets the contents of a certificate directly to the specified value. This is used with lookup plugins or for anything with formatting, or C(content) must be provided when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: issuer_cert
options.description: Issuer certificate used for OCSP monitoring. This parameter is only valid on versions of BIG-IP 13.0.0 or above.

options.name: name
options.description: SSL Certificate Name. This is the cert name used when importing a certificate into the BIG-IP. It also determines the filenames of the objects on the LTM.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Certificate state. This determines if the provided certificate and key is to be made C(present) on the device or C(absent).

options.name: true_names
options.description: When C(true), the module does not append C(.crt) extension to the given certificate name. When C(false), the module appends C(.crt) extension to the given certificate name.
